description:
For hope. For home. For each other. Check out the teaser for the final season of The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon. The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon series stars Norman Reedus and Melissa McBride as Daryl and Carol in this new season set in Spain. Jimmy Smits (NYPD Blue, The West Wing) joins the cast in the new season. The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon premieres on AMC and AMC+ in 2027.

In the final season, while crossing the ravaged badlands of Spain, Daryl (Reedus) and Carol (McBride) grasp onto hope – and each other – as uncertainty about their future grows. Smits plays “Captain Alejandro Perkins,” a former U.S. Navy officer and medical doctor who found a unique way to thrive during the apocalypse. 

The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon also stars Romain Levi, Eduardo Noriega, Óscar Jaenada, Candela Saitta and Hugo Arbués and is executive produced by showrunner David Zabel, Scott M. Gimple, Reedus, McBride, Greg Nicotero, Brian Bockrath, Angela Kang, Jason Richman, Dan Percival and Steve Squillante
title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon Final Season - Official Teaser Trailer (2027) Norman Reedus

Some bonds are stronger than fate. Check out the trailer for Azuki, an upcoming original manga created by artist Arnold Tsang, former Character Art Director for Overwatch. The series premieres September 17 at 9:00 AM PDT and will be available to read free exclusively on Azuki.com, with new chapters releasing on the third Thursday of every month. This cinematic trailer for Azuki introduces you to the manga's world: a story of two sisters, ancient Gates, and a bond tested across worlds.

When Shao's sister Rei disappears beyond the mysterious Gates, her search pulls her into a conflict that threatens both worlds. As long-buried secrets emerge, Shao must confront impossible choices that will test family bonds, trust, and destiny.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

description: Get a closer look at gameplay from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake in this latest video for the upcoming remake of the 1998 adventure game. This new gameplay video, led by series producer Eiji Aonuma, showcases Kokiri Village, Hyrule Field, and Hyrule Castle Town. We get to see new, overhauled visuals with reimagined graphics, and new mechanics, including the ability to rotate the camera, jumps which are now done via button presses versus automatically in the original game, and the addition of new dialogue. We also get a look at dungeon gameplay in the Great Deku Tree, throwing Deku nuts and using the slingshot item to solve puzzles and fight enemies. New features also show that time no longer stops in towns, and day and night cycles will continue. You can also hum songs Link has learned that will play on the Ocarina, and the game will also react to instruments. Additionally, a new feature is Threads of Time, where you can see progress you've made in your story and check y
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Gameplay Revealed!

author: IGN
description:
Valheim reviewed by Len Hafer on PC. Also available on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S.

Whether I'm fighting for my life, plundering forgotten barrows, or just watching the sun play across the water in a calm moment of respite, Valheim has created a world I'm consistently joyful to live in and discover. Its gorgeous art style, deadly bosses and dungeons, charming homesteading mechanics, and breathtaking scope each play a few notes of a melody that gets my blood pumping to explore the raging sea, defeat the greatest beasts, and share a piping hot meal with my sisters and brothers in the shield wall. The journey Minecraft started me on back in 2010 culminated in Valheim. This is the oath of the ultimate survival crafting adventure fulfilled and carved into the very bones of the Earth. Valhalla calls. And even after more than 100 hours just on this fresh playthrough, I feel so sad it's over that I'm eager to answer that call again. One day in the sun is a life well
title: Valheim Review
